standard_prerequisites.name: Conditions, bounded-constrained colorings and strong cone avoidance
standard_prerequisites.statement: The section works with conditions, each a triple of a coloring that is constrained by a computable bounding function, a finite stem and an infinite reservoir computing a fixed set D, together with an extension relation on them; the section also proves separately a strong cone-avoidance statement for the finite-dimensional free-set principle stating that for every finite tuple of colorings there is an infinite subset of a given reservoir that avoids the cone of D and is simultaneously free for all of them. The author's own definitions and that proposition are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the step that shows the first defining property of a condition can always be recovered by shrinking the reservoir, which is what lets the rest of the diagonalisation work with arbitrary conditions.

core_obligations: Derive a family of colorings indexed by the nonempty finite tuples over the stem: for each such tuple form the coloring that takes a finite set to the image of the set appended to that tuple under the original coloring, on the domain cut off by the bounding function evaluated at the least element of the tuple (source line 1127).

Apply the strong cone-avoidance proposition finitely many times, once for each of the finitely many derived colorings, to obtain a single infinite subset of the given reservoir that avoids the cone of the fixed set D and is simultaneously free for all of them (source lines 1128-1130).

Verify the required property for that subset: given a finite set drawn from the stem together with the chosen subset and whose least element lies in the stem, split it into its part inside the stem and its part inside the subset, identify the value of the original coloring on it with the value of the derived coloring on the second part, and use freeness of the subset for that derived coloring to conclude that the image meets the subset inside the set itself (source line 1132).

proof_roadmap.step: Define the derived colorings indexed by the nonempty finite tuples over the stem.
Iterate strong cone avoidance finitely many times for all derived colorings at once.
Split a finite set into its stem part and its reservoir part and conclude freeness.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2412.11598v3 的 Lemma lem:fs-preserving-a（源 1121-1125 行，证明 1126-1133 行）：对任意有限串 σ 与满足 max σ < min X、D ⩽̸_T X 的无穷集 X，存在无穷 Y ⊆ X 使 D ⩽̸_T Y，且对每个 s ∈ [σ ∪ Y]^{≤h(·)} 且 min s ∈ σ 都有 f(s) ∩ Y ⊆ s。关键操作不是例行核验：证明要为每个非空有限元组 t ⊆ σ 造出导出着色 f_t(u)=f(t·u)（1127 行），再对**有限多个**导出着色一次性迭代强锥回避，得到同一个既能避开 D 的锥、又对所有 f_t 同时 free 的无穷子集（1128-1130 行），最后把任意 s 拆成 t=s∩σ 与 u=s∩Y，用 f_t-free 性把 f(s)∩Y ⊆ u ⊆ s 拼出来（1132 行）。难点在于「同时 free」这一步必须靠有限次迭代而不是单次应用，且拆解 s 的方式要同时处理 stem 与 reservoir 两部分；原文位置在证明的 1127、1128-1130、1132 行。
